# Transmission, outbreaks and One Health

> *Where do microbes live outside us, and how do they travel between people, animals and the environment?*

::: {.callout-note}
## In preparation
This unit is planned but not yet written. The outline below shows what it will cover.
:::

## Planned content

- Reservoirs, routes, incubation and carriers
- Zoonoses and One Health
- History as investigation: Snow and cholera, Semmelweis and hand washing
- Singapore examples: Nipah 1999, SARS 2003, hand, foot and mouth disease, melioidosis

## Planned interactives

- An epidemic model to explore
- An outbreak-investigation branching case

**Links to other teaching:** Public health; organ-system blocks.
